human_decisions.create_table:
CREATE TABLE human_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	gate_step_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	decision_origin VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'human' NOT NULL, 
	decision_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	state_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	input_artifact_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_snapshot_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	requested_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	decided_by_user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	action VARCHAR(32), 
	comment_text TEXT, 
	decided_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_human_decisions_gate_request UNIQUE (gate_step_id, request_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_human_decisions_type CHECK (decision_type IN ('plan_approval','conflict_resolution')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_human_decisions_origin CHECK (decision_origin IN ('human','policy')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_human_decisions_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','submitted','expired','cancelled','superseded')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_human_decisions_action CHECK (action IS NULL OR action IN ('approve','request_revision','cancel_run','exclude_conflicted_claims','keep_as_unresolved')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_human_decisions_submitted_fields CHECK ((status = 'submitted' AND (decided_by_user_id IS NOT NULL OR decision_origin = 'policy') AND action IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'submitted'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(gate_step_id) REFERENCES research_steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(input_artifact_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decided_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

research_report_edits.create_table:
CREATE TABLE research_report_edits (
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	base_artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	base_artifact_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	markdown TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_research_report_edits_version CHECK (version >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_research_report_edits_markdown CHECK (length(markdown) > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES research_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(base_artifact_id) REFERENCES research_artifacts (id)
)
